_comment: Instance data for core/helpers/live-watchdog.cjs (PostToolUse + PreToolUse). After every `every` successful write calls to a live system's tools, the suite's own check runs; exit 0 = green, exit 1 = red (further writes to that system are refused until a check passes), any other exit or a timeout = could not measure (not red, retried after the next write). writes/repair = regex on the tool name; repair tools pass while red (an undo, a restore). check = argv, no shell, run in the project dir, ~/ expanded — the script and the target state it checks belong to the SUITE, this file only points at them. Keep timeout_s below the hook's timeout in settings (template: 120 s). name = the domain's name in live-read.json: a live-read domain with no suite here is named at every session start (scripts/hook-coverage.py) unless no_check gives the reason. An empty suites list keeps the gate inert; it is named too until "inert_ok": "<reason>" says it is deliberate.
